question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Quite.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in **blank number 1** is** "quite".**
 
• The complete sentence would be *"The effects of plastic bags on the environment are really **quite**__ devastating because there is no disposal method that will really help eliminate the problem."*
 
• Here,** "quite"** is used to emphasize the extent to which plastic bags are harmful to the environment.
 __
 
• Example: "The weather was **quite **pleasant today."
 
• In this context, "quite" is used to emphasize the extent to which the weather was pleasant.
 
 
 
• The word **"vaguely" (option 1) **means in a way that is uncertain, indefinite or unclear. This word is not appropriate here as it does not convey the severity of the issue.
 
• The word **"randomly" (option 2)** means without method or conscious decision. This word is not appropriate here as it does not convey any relevant information.
 
• The word **"seldom" (option 4) **means rarely or infrequently. This word is not appropriate here as it does not convey the severity of the issue.
 
• Overall, "quite" is the most appropriate option here as it helps to emphasize the severity of the issue caused by plastic bags on the environment.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Paragraph:**__ *The effects of plastic bags on the environment are really **(1) __quite__** devastating because there is no disposal method that will really help eliminate the problem. The biggest problem with them is that once they have been (2)______, they end up In the trash, which then ends up in the landfill or is burned. The indefinite period of time that it takes for the average plastic bag to break (3)______ can be literally hundreds of years. Throughout the world, plastic bags are responsible for suffocation and deaths of woodland animals as well as (4)______ soil nutrients. The land litter that is made up of plastic bags has the potential to kill over and over again. It has been estimated that one bag has the potential to inadvertently kill one animal per every three months due to unintentional digestion or inhalation. There are always alternatives to plastic bags and the search for more alternatives continues.*
